ache.title: A W-Engine tier list makes your gear feel wrong
ache.note: This video ranks Zenless Zone Zero’s W-Engines. Tier lists turn your perfectly fine gear into “C tier,” and suddenly your account feels behind. That itch is how gear you never needed starts to feel necessary. Your team doesn’t get weaker because a list says so.
watch: the feeling your account is behind
lists that turn into shopping lists
ache.tip: Use the tier list as trivia, not a shopping list. If you’re clearing content, your gear is fine.
lines: C tier still clears. trust me
a list can’t nerf your account
